name: scrouge-market
description: Trendalyse Google Trends market intelligence website and Scrouge market idea CLI.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm run start:web
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/web/public/*.html src/web/public/*.css src/web/public/robots.txt src/web/public/sitemap.xml dist/web/public/ && cp -R src/web/public/images dist/web/public/
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
